finding.comment: The audit job now executes from the mutable main branch of security-kit with all secrets inherited; a compromised upstream push gains token access to this repository. The pinning contract is undone.

files.patch:
--- a/.github/workflows/audit.yml
+++ b/.github/workflows/audit.yml
@@ -2,5 +2,5 @@
 jobs:
   audit:
-    uses: acme/security-kit/.github/workflows/audit.yml@f3a4b5c6d7e8f90112a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c1d2e3
+    uses: acme/security-kit/.github/workflows/audit.yml@main
     secrets: inherit
